faculty.introduction: Prof. Abhishek Ghosh currently serves as the Dean of Faculty for Dharma Studies at Somaiya Vidhavihar University, Mumbai. He is a distinguished leader in the field of Hindu Studies, well known for his popular courses and his understanding of ancient Indian wisdom. He is an award winning professor well known for his innovative approach to education and has almost two decades of international higher education experience. As he oversees the Jain, Buddhist, and Bharatiya Sanskriti Peetham Centers at Somaiya Vidyavihar University housed under the K.J. Somaiya Institute for Dharma Studies. Dr. Ghosh fosters a holistic and interdisciplinary environment that bridges diverse Dharmic traditions. His leadership is marked by a commitment to preserving and promoting India's rich spiritual heritage while encouraging critical inquiry and dialogue among scholars. Through his work, Dr. Ghosh is advancing the study and practice of these traditions, ensuring their relevance in contemporary discourse. His research specialization is in Vaishnava traditions, and he serves as the Director of the Institute for Vaishnava Studies, a degree granting research organization in Gainesville, USA recognized by the Commission for Independent Education, Florida Department of Education. He is an expert in South Asian religions and philosophy, focusing on the preservation and translation of classical texts to make them more accessible to wider audiences. He also serves as the senior editor of the Journal of Vaishnava Studies, the longest-running academic journal in Hindu Studies in the Western world. His research interests include Indian epics, yoga, and meditation, and his expertise in these areas has led him to represent India’s security council reform interests at the United Nations in December 2023 on behalf of the Permanent Mission of India, New York. Since 2005, Prof. Ghosh has spoken at various forums and cultural events representing Hinduism and India (or Bharat). He has taught at various universities and was a tenure-line professor at Grand Valley State University, Michigan, and an award-winning instructor at the Graham School of General Studies at the University of Chicago, where he taught Asian Classics. He is also active in interfaith engagement, serving as a board member of the Society for Hindu-Christian Studies, USA, and has contributed numerous articles and book chapters in various scholarly and public intellectual publications. He received his M.A. & Ph.D. in South Asian Languages and Civilizations from the University of Chicago in 2014, following a Masters of Studies in Theology & Religious Studies from Oxford University, UK, in 2006.

projects: : SIMULATION OF SOLAR BASED COLD STORAGE FOR FRUITS AND VEGETABLES at CTARA, IITB - The energy demand and greenhouse gas emission of traditional cold storage leads to global warming. The cooling process of the room is properly carried out in the purpose to ensure high quality and safety of products. This study examined a room with a surface of 35×29×17 (ft) and a well-insulated chamber and examined the heat exchange from the side surfaces and ceiling. Heat and mass transfer in cold rooms is a complex phenomenon because of the presence of the air flow and the coupling between heat transfer and airflow. Temperature, velocity, humidity and heat transfer coefficient measurements were carried out in a ventilated cold room filled with fruits and vegetables. This Project also aims of designing a stacking system for onion which takes care of all aspects. Engineering tools and methodologies has been used first to evaluate the proposed design and analysis the areas of improvement in it to reach the goal of cost effective and user-friendly staking system for onion for medium (50 MT) to large scale (100 MT) onion storage systems. CFD analysis for the staking system have been carried out for the cold room in which stacking system is to be stored.

: Design, Development and Simulation of Electric Ambu-Lifts for Airport Application at Nandan GSE - Ambu-Lift is a kind of a special-purpose vehicle with airport specific application to attend, lower down, lift, and transport patients and disabled persons from ground to aircraft deck and contrariwise easily in normal as well as emergency conditions. These ambu-lifts operate on diesel chassis and thus have harmful exhaust gas emissions, high noise and lower fuel economy as well as higher maintenance for their operations. The project e-Ambulift demonstrates the electrification of an Ambulift right from design, simulation and experimentation. in this e-Ambulift project, a simulation model for the electric vehicle has been created in matlab simulink software wherein the input parameters are fed into the model for the required output results that are necessary for the e-ambulift. The created simulink model is firstly verified with the results from other papers published in reputed journals. The results of simulation from matlab simulink model for defined parameters are compared with the results obtained by experimentation / testing of the real- world Electric Ambu-Lift developed from the same defined inputs. Various output parameters like total energy consumption, vehicle speed, battery voltage, current, State of Charge (SOC) and distance(range) are evaluated from simulation and compared with experimental results for self-defined drive cycle and input parameters in this project. The results are also obtained on simulation model for various available drive cycles. This project also includes the effect of regenerative braking and auxiliary loads on the output parameters. The project concludes with the comparative analysis of the electric ambu-lift with more aspects of future work in this domain.

faculty.introduction: Dr Anand B Bodhale is an Associate Professor at the K J Somaiya School of Languages and Literature, Somaiya Vidyavihar University. With nearly two decades of teaching experience, he has worked extensively with undergraduate and postgraduate students across diverse disciplines. He has taught a wide spectrum of subjects, including Communication Skills, Professional Communication Skills, Business Communication and Ethics, Presentation and Communication Techniques, and Life Skills through English Literature. At the postgraduate level, his expertise covers Indian English Literature, Literature of Resistance, Introduction to Literary Study, Interpretation and Appreciation Skills in Literary Study and other core courses from the MA Programme in English Literature and Communication Studies. He has presented research papers at numerous national and international conferences and has to his credit journal publications, book chapters, and one course book. In addition, he serves as the PG and PhD Coordinator at the School. Dr. Bodhale’s research interests include Applied English, English Language Teaching (ELT), Technical Communication and Technical Writing, Literature of the Oppressed and Marginalized, Literature of Resistance, African American Literature, Cultural Studies, Indian Writing in English, Auto-narratives, Postcolonial Literature, and Dalit Autobiographies.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Anuja Agarwal is a Delhi University Graduate in Computer Science, holds a Masters degree in Computer Application(MCA) from DAVV, Indore and a Ph.D. in Management Studies from Mumbai University. Her Ph.D. thesis is in Design-Thinking and Innovation. She has recently authored a Best-seller Book Titled “Design Thinking: A Framework for Applying Design Thinking in Problem-Solving”, published by Cengage Publishers, which has been adopted by top B-Schools in India, including some of the IIMs. Having learnt ‘Design Thinking’ at some of the top names in the world, namely Stanford D-School and IDEO, followed by her Ph.D. thesis in ‘Applying Design-Thinking in Management Education’, Dr. Anuja Agarwal has developed expertise in an end-to-end process of applying Design-thinking concepts to create Innovative solutions that solve problems, and facilitate the companies to manage their Innovation process and make it Sustainable. Socially relevant Projects undertaken with application of Design-Thinking process - AI-Powered Smart Jewellery Box. Smart Tap that empowers 'Water-users' to become 'Water-conservers'. Developing Strategies for Alternate Energy based Business Ecosystems in Rural India ‘Jaggery to Jags’ for enhancing local income through high-end positioning of Jaggery in the market by making it available in convenient, attractive, micro-unit sizes and modern flavours, akin to Chocolate bars. Project GELL-AMAR - GEnerating Local Livelihood to Arrest Migration & Aid Reverse-migration project in Ladakh. Sustainable Water Resource Management Solution to enhance livelihoods. This Water Conservation Project at Village Kheware in Rural Maharashtra is being worked on using a combination of design-thinking principles and innovative hollow shaft technology. Zero Waste City with ‘Smart Taps’ Project - This project is aimed at reduction, segregation and collection of household waste, measuring to minimise energy & water consumption and educating people about hazards/impact of overconsumption. Waste-to-value solutions benefiting farmer community – written a case study of the work done by CSR arm of a leading organisation in India. Project ‘Pace’- Personal metronome: a low-cost concept product to help manage ‘Freezing’ in Parkinson’s patients. Software tool for supporting Ethnographic Research in Innovation Projects which was presented at a conference, ‘Technology for Education’ held at IIT, Bombay. Dr. Anuja has also joined a mission of providing world class Computer science education to bright underprivileged children in India. She does this assignment on pro-bono basis as the Founding Dean at Sitare University.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Aparna Bhat started her career as a Chartered Accountant and earned the Financial Risk Manager (FRM) certification from the Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP), USA. In addition she holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Treasury and Forex Risk Management from ICFAI. Her doctoral research revolved around the pricing and hedging of exchange-traded currency options in India. She is currently working with the K.J.Somaiya Institute of Management Studies (K J SIM) as Associate Professor in the area of FInance and facilitates courses on Derivatives, Financial Risk Management and Financial Management. She has a total work experience of 29 years till date of which 14 were spent in the corporate sector in various areas such as audit, finance and accounts and risk management. Before joining K J SIM, Dr. Aparna Bhat led the Risk Management Team at the National Stock Exchange (NSE) Head Office in Mumbai. Her research interests are in the areas of stock markets, financial derivatives and financial risk management models. She is empanelled as a trainer with the National Institute of Securities Markets (NISM) and has conducted several Continuing Education Programmes on Equity and Currency derivatives and Capital Market Operations for the members of stock exchanges. She is a committed teacher and passionate about her teaching and research.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Arihant Kumar Jain is an Assistant Professor and a recognized Ph.D. Guide at the Centre for Studies in Jainism, K. J. Somaiya Institute of Dharma Studies, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai.He obtained his Ph.D. degree from Deptt. of Philosophy, University of Mumbai. He has also served as Visiting Faculty in the Department of Philosophy, University of Mumbai. He has five books to his credit so far, out of which he is the author of three and editor of two. He is the Honorable Member of Board of Studies as Subject Expert in Department of Philosophy at Bhavan's College (Autonomous), Mumbai. He has represented Jainism at an International Conference held in Colombo (Srilanka) and has presented his research papers in about 25 National and International seminars & more than 18 of his research articles have also been published in various reputed research journals. He has also played an important role in coordinating National and International conferences as well as conducting the Prakrit Lecture Series and National Seminars & Webinars as Convenor, sponsored by ICPR and ICHR. He has directed a documentary film ‘Prakrit Language – An Ancient Prosperous Tradition’, depicting the historical and archaeological importance of Sravanabelagola (Karnataka), which has been screened in a couple of National and International film festivals. He is the founding Hon. Editor of 'The Prakrit Times International eNewsletter' for the promotion and propagation of the oldest Prakrit language and literature globally, as well as an Associate Editor of Jain Avenue Web Magazine (jainavenue.org). He has been awarded UGC NET-JRF and Dr. S. Radhakrishnan Post Doctoral Fellowship from UGC, New Delhi. He got Best Performer Award at National Level One Month Faculty Induction Programme, organised by Teaching Learning Centre under PMMMNMTT scheme, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India. He has been honored with the ‘Rashtriya Gaurav Award’ and ‘Charukeerthi Bhattaraka Swami Sravanabelagola Memorial Shriphal Patrakarita Award’ for his innovative contribution.

faculty.introduction: Brief Information- Avadhut Patwardhan works as an Assistant Professor at the K J Somaiya Institute of Management, Somaiya Vidyavihar University (SVU), Mumbai, India. His domain of specialisation is Marketing. His primary responsibilities are to deliver courses related to his domain (Marketing Management, Integrated Marketing Communication, consumer Behaviour, International Marketing, B2B Marketing and Sales Management). He likes to use case studies and designs relevant activities for student engagement as a part of pedagogy. He has trained himself for such pedagogical techniques by attending seminar organized by Harvard Business Publishing and IIM-A case center. Highest Qualification- Avadhut pursued his doctoral degree as a full-time research scholar from National Institute of Industrial Engineering (NITIE), Mumbai a premier institute now known as Indian Institute of Management Mumbai, India. His research interest is Technology Adoption. His preferred methodology of research is Empirical Approach. The preferred techniques that he use for data analysis is Structural Equation Modeling (SEM). He can deal with AMOS and PLS-SEM in R software. Research Capacity and Interests- His research interests are to examine technology adoption of various technologies, with special reference to developing economies like India. He is also an aspiring candidate for Post-doctoral position in the area of services marketing in general and service quality in specific. Recently, he is emphasising on examining impact of ESERVQUAL determinants on perceived values amongst the Ola and Uber users. For addressing the pre-defined research questions, he mainly prefers theory testing or theory development approach and focuses on primary data collected from the customers using self-administered or online questionnaire. Research Publications and Outcomes- He has published research papers in the journals of international repute like Journal of Medical Marketing and the International Journal of Healthcare Management. He has co-authored two articles with his dissertation supervisor and mentor out of which one got published in International Journal of Product Development and other one is published by International Journal of Electronic Banking. He has also co-authored a case study published at the Case-center. Awards and Recognition- Received Best Thesis award during a competition held by Prestige Institute of Management, Gwalior, India.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Barsharani Maharana is presently working as an Assistant Professor in the Department of Business Analytics at K J Somaiya Institute of Management, Somaiya Vidyavihar University. Dr. Barsharani has competency to handle statistical and demographic software packages, and strong ability to implement numerous surveys. She has handled large scale survey data like National Sample Survey, National Family Health Survey, District Level Household Survey and India Human Development Survey and has published research articles in areas of health economics, ageing, mortality, reproductive health, maternal and child health in peer reviewed journals. Dr. Barsharani has more than 3.5 years of teaching experience to post graduate students and 4.4 years of research experience as a team leader in research projects under the aegis of MoHFW Govt of India, UNFPA and USAID.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Bhagyashree Bavare is presently Associate Professor at the K. J. Somaiya Institute of Dharma Studies, Somaiya Vidyavihar University and In-charge Exam Cell for Centre for Buddhist Studies. She is working with Somaiya Centre for Buddhist Studies since November 2012. She has varied experience in the field of teaching and research. At the beginning of her career, she has taught for undergraduate and post - graduate programmes in Sanskrit as well as Indian Preforming Arts. She also has an experience of working as a research assistance on a project 'Archaeo-astronomy in Indian Context' at TIFR. She was also part of a unique course on ancient Indian Astronomy as a visiting teacher at the UMDAE - Centre for Excellence in Basic Sciences in her early years of career. She has published research articles in reputed journals and has presented papers at National and International level conferences. Her main research interest lies in the field of Sanskrit language and literature as well as Buddhist Sanskrit literature. She is also interested in the field of Indian mythology, Narrative literature. Dr. Bavare is also learning and teaching Tibetan language at the institute. She is also interested in research and translation activities at the institute and is keen to explore multi-disciplinary areas of studies.

faculty.introduction: Prof (Dr.) Brajesh Bolia Ph.D.@ IIM Mumbai, UGC-NET, MBA (Marketing), B.E. (Civil) Prof Brajesh Bolia is an Associate Professor in the Marketing & International Business Department & Program Director (MBA Executive Program) at K J Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai. He facilitates the following courses - Sales & Distribution Management, Business to Business Marketing, Business Development, Marketing Management & CRM Before joining academics in 2010, Prof Bolia has worked with the corporate sector for over a decade with organizations such as A V Birla Group (Cement Marketing Div.), ICICI Bank Ltd., BHW Home Finance Ltd & ICICI Prudential Life Insurance Co Ltd and the passion for teaching and engaging with students prompted him to shift to a full-time academic career. He has also served as a visiting faculty with IIM Trichy (Sales & Distribution Management & Marketing Initiatives in International Marketing), IIM Mumbai (Business to Business Marketing), and XIM Bhubaneshwar (Sustainability Marketing). He has delivered Over 300 hours of corporate training sessions (Customer Centricity, Sales Process, and Marketing Dynamics) to over 2000 participants of various categories like Business Centre Heads, Branch Heads, Branch Managers, Senior Managers, and Direct Recruits from various companies like Life Insurance Corporation (LIC), Owens Corning & Schaeffler India, National Insurance Co Ltd, GIC, ECGC, Participants of several Private General Insurance Companies.

faculty.introduction: Prof (Dr.) Chandan Singhavi works as Data Science and Technology faculty at K J Somaiya Institute of Management. She has 23 years of experience in academia. She has been a BOS/ advisory committee/ Subject Board IT/ Data Science member since 2009. Her research is in ICT adoption in Education and technology adoption and has resulted in many national and international publications in renowned journals, including ABDC. Her research has also led to an impact in schools and work of NGOs like Pratham. She is one of the most sought-after resources in Advanced Excel, Business Intelligence, Dashboarding using Tableau/ Qlik Sense, Data Mining, CRM, SAP, ERP, and Simulations for Enterprise systems. MS Project, MS Acces,s and Research Methodology using SPSS. Some of the organizations where she has done training are Godrej and Boycee, LIC, Arkema, Nanavati Hospital, NUVOCO, BCCI, DAE, INS HAMLA, TISS, etc... She has handled consultancy projects for government organizations and NGOs. She is on the panel of CDAC for selection and promotion of their technical employees. She handled different administrative portfolios like Chairperson IT infrastructure, Co-Chairperson Admissions committee, and Member PR committee. In her admissions and IT infrastructure role, she has revamped the entire admissions process, has used technology extensively in every phase which led to the process becoming agile, robust and led to data driven decision making. The organization has benefited in terms of time, informed decision making and increased transparency. The impact of COVID’19 was felt minimal or negligible on the admissions process due to negligible.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Daly Davis is an Associate Professor in Chemistry in the Somaiya Vidyavihar University. She obtained her Ph.D from Cochin University of Science and Technology. She has done her postdoctoral studies from University of Heidelberg, Germany and Israel Institute of Technology-Technion-, Haifa, Israel. Previously, she has worked as a scientist at various institutes of the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) such as Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), Institute of Plasma Research (IPR) and Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC). In addition, she was a visiting faculty member for the Integrated MSc Chemistry Course at the Center for Excellence in Basic Science, Mumbai. She Joined Somaiya Vidyavihar University in 2021 as an assistant professor at S K Somaiya College. She has 19 years of research experience from various academic institutions. She has 22 publications in peer reviewed high impact international journals and numerous international and national conference proceedings. She received public funded research grants from various agencies such as BRNS, CSIR and DST. She was given the SVU Seed Grant as well. She received Dr. S K Somaiya award for Excellence in Research (2022-2023) Her field of research is Chemical Physics. She is currently active in electron – molecule collision experiments and Raman Spectroscopy. Quantum chemical calculations, Astro-chemistry, electron induced chemical reactions in biological and polymeric systems and DNA repair studies are her focus areas. She is a Ph D guide in Chemistry. She is also a consultant in spectroscopy.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Harnesh Makhija is a faculty in the Finance area at K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management (KJSIM), Mumbai. He has a Ph.D. in financial performance evaluation criteria from Mumbai University. He has nearly a decade of teaching experience in corporate finance, project finance, project management, and financial modeling, with a keen understanding of capital markets and financial management. He did his MBA in Finance from Mumbai University, holds a NET certification from UGC, and has enrolled for PMP certification. He conducted various trainings for companies like Wellness Forever, Mahindra & Mahindra (Auto Division), Arkema, Godavari Biorefineries Ltd., Sujan CooperStandard AVS Pvt. Ltd., NSE-SIMSR certified programs, INS Hamla in the area of project finance, project management, financial management and corporate finance. He did funded research project for IRDA research grant scheme titled as “Insurance awareness among millennials: with reference to purchase and policy holders’ protection”. He is actively involved in a funded research project from Somaiya Vidyavihar University titled “M-payment adoption among vendors in India: Barriers and drivers.” His work has been published widely in various peer-reviewed international journals. He has presented research papers at various national and international conferences. He was the International Journal of Business and Globalisation and Sustainability's guest editor. He is a reviewer of several leading international journals. He is a Board of Studies member for VPM’s Joshi Bedekar College (Autonomous), Mumbai. His current role as Associate Professor at K J Somaiya Institute of Management includes teaching, research, training assignments, and various committee work. He is the division in charge of a full-time MBA (Finance) course and an active member of the academic excellence task force.

faculty.introduction: Dr Hema Rajendra Bhadawkar is an Associate Professor at the K J Somaiya School of Education, Somaiya Vidyavihar University. She holds post graduate degrees in Chemistry, History, Education and Philosophy to her credit. She has an academic experience of 19 years, specialising in subjects like Assessment for Learning, Educational Technology, Advanced Research Methodologies in Education, Educational Management, Integrating Technology in Education, Human Resource Management in Education, Pedagogy of History etc. She is certified in various computer applications and organised various workshops in Web tools in teaching, Learning and Assessment. ICT enabled Education, Pedagogical innovations and Educational Technology and Assessment find dominance among her areas of interest in research in Education. She has completed ICSSR sponsored major research on “Enhancing Conceptual Understanding about Astronomical Concepts among Visually Impaired Students: A Technology Based Inquiry Approach" and Mumbai University sponsored minor research on ''Empowering the pre-service teachers for ICT mediated language instruction: a Problem based learning (PBL) approach.'' She has authored two books: Foundations of OB and HRM and Assessment for Learning. She has successfully guided M Ed dissertation of University of Mumbai, IGNOU, YCMOU and Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai. She is a research guide and has published and presented more than 30 Research papers in State, National and International Conferences and Seminars. Visit: https://sites.google.com/somaiya.edu/dr-hema-bhadawkar/home

faculty.introduction: Dr Hitesh Punjabi is a Assitant Professor, Department of Finance, K J Somaiya Institute of Management Studies and Research, Mumbai. He is MBA (Finance), B.E(Chemical) and PhD( Management Studies), Alumina of IIM Indore and SEBI Registered Research Analyt. He has more than 20+ years of experience in industry and management education. Earlier he was with leading corporations likes Anand Rathi Securities, Religare Securities, HSBCInvest Direct Securities, East India Securities, ARJ Securities in the field of Equity Research and with Chetana's Institute of Management & Research. He has also conducted FDPs and MDPs on a variety of topics for reputed several organizations. He has chaired many research conferences, workshops and seminars. Dr. Hitesh has contributed articles and has published research papers in national and international publications. He is active Member of Indian Pharmaceutical Association. He is Mentor for Atal Incubation Centre supported by NITI-AAYOG. He has been a Visiting Faculty for Finance at various institutes of Management since 2003. His areas of expertise are of Security Analysis & Portfolio Management, Equity Research- Fundamental Analysis, Technical Analysis, Mutual Funds, Behavioural Finance and Algorithm Trading.

faculty.introduction: I COMPLETED PH.D. FROM DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY SCIENCE AND ENGINEERING FROM INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, BOMBAY, MUMBAI, INDIA ON JULY 2011. POST PH.D. I WORKED AS ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR FROM 2011 TO 2016 AND FROM 2016 ONWARD WORKED AS PROFESSOR AND DEAN RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT IN K J Somaiya SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING MUMBAI. &NBSP;I AM WORKING ON THE MULTI CROP DRYING CUM GRINDING SYSTEM FOR HERB AND GRAINS. THE PROJECT HELPS TO PROVIDE THE SOLUTION TO GRIVANVASI ASHRAM DHANU FOR DRYING OF HERBS AND FRUITS. I ALSO DEVELOPED THE TURMERIC BOILING CUM DRYING UNIT WHICH WORKS ON BIOMASS FUEL. THE SYSTEM IS MORE EFFICIENT AS AGAINST THE PRESENT PROCESS USED BY FRAMERS. ALONG WITH THE INDUSTRY I AM WORKING ON THE TECHNOLOGY SOLUTION FOR THE BAGASSE ASH BRICKS (PATENT FILED) MANUFACTURING FROM BOTTOM ASH GENERATED FROM SUGAR COGENERATION INDUSTRY (PRESENTLY TOTAL 652 SUGAR CANE INDUSTRIES IN INDIA). I DEVELOPED THE VACUUM DRYING UNIT FOR THE BAGASSE DRYING, WHICH THEN USED IN THE COGENERATION PLANT. THE TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPED REDUCES THE MOISTURE UP TO 8% MAXIMUM (PATENT FILED).THE HEAT ASSISTED EVAPORATION HAS BEEN PRACTICE WORLDWIDE; I AM WORKING ON THE FREEZE SOLUTION RECOVERY SYSTEM SO THAT TWO UTILITIES CAN BE PRODUCE FORM THE NATURAL AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE (GUR OR JAGGERY). I DEVELOPED THE SOLAR BASED INCINERATOR SYSTEM FOR THE TEXTILE MILL WHICH THEN GENERATES THE HOT WATER FOR THE PROCESS INDUSTRY (PATENT FILED ON THE PROCESS DEVELOPED). THE OTHER AREA I AM WORKING WITH IS SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT FOR INDUSTRIES. I AM PRESENTLY LOOKING FOR THE GRINDING WASTE UTILIZATION FOR THE USEFUL PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT. FURTHER I AM ALSO LOOKING FOR THE ALUMINUM WASTE UTILIZATION AND ITS MMC PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT. I AM ALSO CLOSELY WORKING ON SMALL SCALE INDUSTRIES IN BHIWANDI AREA, FOR THE PEARL AND BEADS DYEING AND DRYING I DEVELOPED THE PEARL SEPARATION DEVICE (PATENT FILED) AND PEARL MIXING DEVICE (PATENT FILED) WHICH CURRENTLY BEING USED FOR THE REGULAR PRODUCTION.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Ketan Mulchandani, FRM, FIII, FMVA, is an accomplished academician and finance expert with over 18 years of diverse experience, including 12+ years in academia and 6 years in the industry, particularly in the commodity and equity markets. Currently, he is a Professor of Finance at K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai. Holding a PhD in Finance from Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore, and an MBA in Finance, Dr. Ketan is equipped with prestigious certifications such as Financial Risk Manager (FRM), Financial Modeling & Valuation Analyst (FMVA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), CFA Level-3 candidate, and NSE Certified Capital Market Professional (NCCMP). His specialization includes derivatives, risk management, corporate finance, financial markets, and corporate governance. Dr. Ketan's research interests span corporate finance, banking, ESG, earnings management, corporate governance, financial markets, financial derivatives, financial performance, insurance, and mutual funds. He has an extensive portfolio of research publications in reputed ABDC and Scopus-indexed journals. He chairs the Research Excellence Taskforce and actively contributes to key institutional committees. Dr Ketan’s contributions have earned him accolades, including the Best Research Paper Award in 2021 and the NPTEL Star distinction in Management.

faculty.introduction: Dr Kiran Sharma is a Professor and Area Chairperson in Marketing and International Business at the K. J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai. Prior to this, she was the Co-Coordinator for the PGDM (Retail Management) program for the last ten years. Dr Kiran was the Chairperson of the SIMSR Global Marketing Conference and has also spearheaded the National Retail Summit for several years. She has 15 years of experience in academics including the D.Y. Patil School of Management, Navi Mumbai along with 7 years of industry experience with Sahara India Pariwar, Lucknow. As a committed academician, she has taught some of interesting courses at the Institute. I have also taken up some visiting assignments and mentored countless students in their pursuit of academic and professional success. Dr Sharma teaches courses on Marketing Strategy, Consumer Behaviour, International Marketing, and Marketing Management. She has presented and published several papers in both National and International Journals and has attended various conferences of international repute. She has attended workshops on Marketing Strategy at Harvard University and Mixed Methods Research at St. Gallen, Switzerland. She is also keenly interested in the case study development of Indian corporate. Dr Sharma is keenly interested in research areas like Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Strategy, Consumer Decision Making, and the Relevance of emotions in Consumer Behaviour. Her dedication to research has resulted in publications in top academic journals and has been invited to speak at research conferences. Her work in consumer behaviour has focused on understanding the underlying motivations and drivers of consumer behaviour and has explored a wide range of topics, from the impact of social influence on decision-making to the role of emotions in consumer behaviour. Dr Sharma has a Master’s in psychology and an M.B.A. from the University of Lucknow specializing in International Business and Marketing and a PhD from Saurashtra University.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Kishan Jee is a Professor specializing in Sustainable Finance, ESG, Circular Economy, and Microfinance, with vast experience spanning teaching, research, academic leadership, and institutional administration. He has built a strong international research profile with 26+ peer-reviewed publications in ABDC, SCOPUS, and UGC-CARE indexed journals. He has also authored three academic books and contributed 17 book chapters, six of which appear in SCOPUS-indexed volumes (including publishers such as Springer Nature, IGI Global, Emerald, and an IEEE conference proceeding), alongside additional chapters in edited volumes and conference proceedings. Prior to joining Somaiya Vidyavihar University, he served as Professor and Head of the Department of Commerce at Brainware University, Kolkata (Nov 2023– Mar 2026), where he led postgraduate programmes, organised international conferences — including convening the 1st International Conference on Industry 5.0: Connecting Humans and Machines for Sustainable Development (2024) — developed industry partnerships (including strategic MoUs with NISM, BSE, and KPMG), guided doctoral scholars, and contributed to NAAC and academic governance as Convenor of the university's NAAC Core Team. He also served as Associate Professor and Head of the Faculty of Commerce at Gopal Narayan Singh University, Bihar (2018–2023), where he strengthened research culture, curriculum innovation, and institutional administration, including chairing the Departmental Research Committee and Departmental Academic Committee. He holds a Ph.D. in Finance from Banaras Hindu University (BHU), Varanasi. Alongside his primary role, he holds additional affiliations as a doctoral research guide at IIT Patna and in association with Lincoln University, Malaysia. His academic excellence has been recognised through several prestigious honours, including the Faculty of the Year Award (2025) from the London School of Digital Business, London, and the Best Paper Award (2025) at ICEIG 2025, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi. He has been an invited speaker and resource person at numerous national and international conferences and seminars, and holds two published patents and one copyright in areas spanning IoT-based supply chain optimization, blockchain-based academic credentialing, and AI-powered adaptive learning.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Krupa A Rai is an ardent researcher and a passionate academic. She has a 16+ year record of achievement and demonstrated success in developing and delivering management courses to the MBA program. She has held various administrative positions at different state universities in India. She specializes in qualitative and quantitative research methods such as structural equation modeling, fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA), phenomenology, and applied ethnography. She critically investigates conspicuous consumption, conscious consumption, consumption paradox, and consumers' well-being as her research interests. Dr. Krupa A Rai is a qualified UGC-NET in Management and holds her Ph.D. in consumer behavior from VTU, Belgaum, Karnataka. She enjoys exploring academic writing and owns her microblogging site.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Manisha Ramesh Gawde is an Assistant Professor of K. J. Somaiya College of Education, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai. She completed her post graduate degrees in Economics, Education from University of Mumbai. She completed her Ph.D. under the guidance of Dr.Hemlata Chari,Deputy Director (IDOL),University of Mumbai in 2015.She began her career from secondary school and went on to become faculty at teacher education colleges. Presently she is a Counsellor and Research Guide for M A (Education) at IGNOU study centre 1601.She presented papers at state and national level. She is associated as field coordinator at DLLE, Mumbai University. From last three years she is a member of Selection Committee to select Best Teacher of the year for Mayor Award. Her areas of scholarly interest include Educational Psychology ,Guidance & Counseling, School Counselling, Inclusive Education, Self Management and Life Skills,Learning and Teaching Pedagogy of School subject Economics and Commerce at the B Ed level. Before joining Somaiya’s in 2017, she worked for the B.Ed College as an Assistant Professor for nearly 11 years. In this institution, she teaches Learning and Teaching, Pedagogy of School Subject Economics, Education for All : Disability,Diversity & Inclusion to B.Ed and Educational Management, Psychology of Learning and Development,Guidance and Counselling to M.Ed.

She is a Pharmaceutical Biotechnology and Life Sciences faculty and has taught several subjects at the UG, PG and Ph.D. programmes. She is an active Academician and a Researcher and has expertise in exploring natural and synthetic compounds and leads for pharmaceutical and biological application, Anticancer agents, Neuroprotection in AD progression. She is Fellow of Society for Applied Biotechnology and a life time member of Biotech Research Society of India. She has been awarded so far with extramural research grants from funding agencies including Department of Biotechnology, Science Engineering Research Board, SERB POWER grants from Govt. of India worth 10 million (100 lakhs). faculty.introduction: Ms. Mousmi Rathod(Pawar) is an academician, researcher, and technology educator specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cyber Security, and interdisciplinary educational technologies. Her scholarly interests extend to interdisciplinary applications of AI, educational analytics, and emerging technologies that contribute to the transformation of higher education. With extensive experience in teaching, curriculum development, academic leadership, and research mentorship, She is committed to advancing impactful research, fostering innovation, and contributing to the global academic community.

faculty.introduction: Ms. Nandini Ajay Rai is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Science and Humanities at K. J. Somaiya School of Engineering, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai, with over 20 years of teaching experience in Engineering Mathematics. Her areas of specialization include Linear Algebra and Mathematics Education, with a strong focus on innovative pedagogy, blended learning, and outcome-based education. She has taught a wide range of undergraduate engineering courses such as Applied Mathematics (I–IV), Probability and Statistics, Optimization Techniques, Computational Mathematics, Discrete Mathematics, Integral Transforms, and Mathematics for various engineering disciplines. She is an approved UG teacher of the University of Mumbai and Somaiya Vidyavihar University. Ms. Rai holds an M.Sc. in Mathematics from the University of Mumbai, where she was awarded the Gold Medal, and she has qualified UGC–CSIR NET with a national rank. Her research contributions include peer-reviewed publications in reputed international journals, particularly in the area of engineering mathematics education, assessment strategies, and learning management systems. She has actively participated in and contributed to numerous faculty development programs, MOOCs, NPTEL courses, and national workshops, and has delivered expert talks and training sessions on topics such as Fourier Series, MATLAB, R Programming, and innovative mathematics teaching practices. She has also played key roles in curriculum design, academic planning, quality assurance, and institutional committees, demonstrating sustained commitment to academic leadership and continuous improvement in higher education.

faculty.introduction: DR. NINAD DILEEP MEHENDALE, IS A POST DOCTORATE FROM KIT GERMANY AND CURRENTLY WORKING AS AN ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR IN THE ELECTRONICS DEPARTMENT AT K.J. Somaiya SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING. DR. NINAD HAS OFFERED A VARIETY OF NEXT-GENERATION SUBJECTS AT KJSCE, WHICH ARE AR-VR SYSTEMS, SOUND AND MUSIC ENGINEERING, 3D PRINTING TECHNOLOGIES, ADVANCED DIY ELECTRONICS, FILMMAKING AND AUDIO EDITING, AND DEEP LEARNING WITH AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES. PRIOR TO KJSCE, HE WAS WORKING AS A SCIENTIST WITH THE INSTITUTE OF MICROSTRUCTURE TECHNOLOGY AT KARLSRUHE INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, GERMANY FOR 1 YEAR. DURING THIS PERIOD, HE DEVELOPED A 'REAL-TIME MICROFLUIDIC BIOREACTOR WITH NMR MEASUREMENT CAPABILITIES'. HE ALSO DEVELOPED A MACHINE-LEARNING ALGORITHM TO CLASSIFY FTIR SIGNALS OBTAINED DURING WASTE TO THE BIOFUEL PRODUCTION PROCESS. HE HAS ALSO WORKED AS FACULTY AT THE VIDYALANKAR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY FOR 6 MONTHS AND AT D.J. SANGHVI COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING FOR 6 YEARS. DR. NINAD HOLDS A PH.D. DEGREE IN MICROFABRICATION AND IMAGE PROCESSING FROM THE INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY BOMBAY. DURING HIS PH.D. WORK, HE DEVELOPED A HAND-HELD CELL SORTING MACHINE USING PASSIVE MICROFLUIDICS. HIS RESEARCH PRODUCT RAPID DEVICE WAS INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED AS THE ONLY FINALIST FROM INDIA TO MAKE IT INTO THE PRESTIGIOUS HOUCHEN PORTABLE MICROFLUIDICS AWARD DURING THE MICROTAS 2017 CONFERENCE IN THE USA. HE WAS A GOLD MEDALLIST DURING HIS M.TECH. AT NMIMS UNIVERSITY. DURING HIS MASTER'S, HE DEVELOPED A TWO-AXIS TRACKING SYSTEM FOR MAXIMUM POWER TRANSFER, WHICH WAS REVOLUTIONARY AT THAT TIME. HE ALSO HOLDS A BACHELOR OF ENGINEERING DEGREE IN ELECTRONICS AND TELECOMMUNICATION AND A DIPLOMA IN INDUSTRIAL ELECTRONICS. DURING HIS DIPLOMA, HE RECEIVED A RATAN TATA SCHOLARSHIP FOR BEING A TOPPER IN THE MSBTE DIPLOMA EXAMS. DR. NINAD IS THE FOUNDER AND WAS CHIEF- RESEARCHER FOR 11 YEARS AT NINAD`S RESEARCH LAB AT THANE. HE MADE MORE THAN 2200 PROJECTS IN VARIOUS DOMAINS RANGING FROM COMPUTER PROGRAMMING TO ROBOTICS. DR. NINAD IS CURRENTLY CONSULTING MANY INDUSTRIES, SUCH AS STEMI (EUROPE), XENIUM DIGITAL (INDIA), AND LOFTI ZADE CENTER OF EXCELLENCE (INDIA). ALSO, DR. MEHENDALE IS CONSULTING MANY ACADEMIC INSTITUTIONS LIKE VIDYALANKAR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, SBMP, TERNA GROUP OF INSTITUTIONS, AND KOHINOOR TECHNICAL INSTITUTE. HIS CURRENT RESEARCH IS GOING IN THE FIELD OF SOUND SIGNAL PROCESSING, WHERE IS RECEIVED A MUMBAI UNIVERSITY, MINOR PROJECT GRANT, TO DEVELOP A ROBOTIC EAR SYSTEM FOR AN EMERGENCY VEHICLE SUCH AS AN AMBULANCE AND USE IOT TO GENERATE THE ALARM SIGNAL. ALSO, HE IS WORKING ON A COLLABORATIVE PROJECT, WITH IIT MANDI, IN DEVELOPING PLANT DISEASE DETECTION USING MACHINE VISION AND DEVELOPING AN AUTONOMOUS SENSOR-BASED SYSTEM FOR THE PLANT GROWTH CHAMBER. HIS CORE AREAS OF EXPERTISE ARE SIGNAL PROCESSING, MACHINE VISION, EMBEDDED SYSTEMS, MICROFLUIDICS AND MICROFABRICATION, MEMS, NMR AND BIOPROCESSING OF WASTE, ROBOTICS, DEEP LEARNING, AND AR-VR TECHNOLOGY. SUBJECT SPECIALIZATION: ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING, TELECOMMUNICATION ENGINEERING, BIO-MEDICAL ENGINEERING, MACHINE LEARNING, IMAGE PROCESSING AND COMPUTER VISION. FOR MORE DETAILS PLEASE VISIT THE OFFICIAL WEBSITE: DRNINAD.WEEBLY.COM

faculty.introduction: Dr. Parvathi is a Research Coordinator at Somaiya Institute of Research and Consultancy with professional skills in blending research design and creative communication. Her responsibilities involve assisting Director-SIRAC in establishing a research innovation ecosystem, develop research-oriented academic & outreach programmes in SIRAC, and coordinate national and global alliances research activities. She has been associated with the research promotion wing since its inception in 2017 which has evolved into SIRAC, a research institute with a core focus on interdisciplinary research activities involving Molecular System Biology. She is a graduate in Biochemistry, postgraduate & doctorate in Biotechnology, and also holds a postgraduate diploma in packaging. She is a Life Sciences professional with a teaching-cum-research experience of over 13 years. Dr. Parvathi started her career as a research associate in Manovikas Kendra, Kolkata on the ‘role of HOX genes in Autism’ followed by working as an Assistant Professor in School of Biotechnology & Bioinformatics, & D Y Patil University, Mumbai, where she completed her Ph.D. on ‘Barcoding and Genetic Diversity in Microbes’. Dr. Parvathi has 9 research publications in both national & international journals; NCBI sequence submission of 103 partial 16S ribosomal sequences and probe data comprising 400 micro-diverse ribosomal sequences for differentiating UTI pathogens. Her notable achievement is the development of molecular diagnostic probes for nosocomial infections: 23SP1880- exclusive for identification and differentiation of E. coli from other urinary tract infection pathogens and 23SP2682 – for identifying and categorizing clonal strains of E. coli. She has been granted 2 copyrights and a trademark for the algorithm and software developed for microbial DNA barcoding. Dr. Parvathi holds a patent (one pending) in Biotechnology for developing an innovative gel assembly unit capable of dual-run orientation. She has guided over 20 under-graduate & post-graduate projects and has successfully completed a minor project funded by the University of Mumbai and 2 consultancy projects funded by DRDO. In addition to her research interests in microbial barcoding and diversity studies, Dr. Parvathi is passionate about research education and science communication activities. She encourages knowledge sharing through the creative illustration of biosciences concepts and runs a bioscientoon based informative blog for budding researchers, bioscience educations, undergraduate science enthusiasts to promote research, learning, and communication in bioscience.

faculty.introduction: Dr Pooja Birwatkar has pursued her post doctoral research from Homi Bhabha Centre of Science Education and holds a Ph.D from Centre of Advanced Study in Education (CASE), Baroda. She holds a Masters degree in science (Zoology) and Master’s in Education from CASE. At Master’s of Education level she has been a University topper and secured a distinction along with 2 gold Medals for securing highest percentage. She has also completed a Post Graduate Diploma in Industrial Relation and Personnel Management-(IRPM). Dr Pooja Birwatkar has throughout been meritorious students and earned a junior research fellowship (JRF) from ICSSR (Indian Council of Social Science Research) as well as scholarship from M.S University, Baroda for Ph.D. Dr Pooja Birwatkar had been a visiting scientist at HBCSE where she pursued her post doctoral research from 2012-2014. She also worked as a Consultant with Observer Research Foundation (ORF) Mumbai. Dr Pooja Birwatkar is presently I C Director at the K. J. Somaiya School of Education. Her areas of interest include research in science; inquiry based learning, diversity, design thinking, innovative pedagogies and science education as well as environment education.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Pradeep Kumar is an Assistant Professor in the area of Marketing & International Business at KJ Somaiya Institute of Management, Somaiya Vidya Vihar University, Mumbai. He has around 11 years of State Govt Experience at various capacities (State Services, Govt. of Jharkhand) and around 08 Years of post-PhD academic experience. His teaching interests are International Marketing, Services Marketing, Healthcare Marketing, Branding of Healthcare Products & Services, Neuromarketing, and B2B in Healthcare. His research interests lie in Service Science, Flexible mechanisms in Marketing, Experiential Value, Brain mapping, and Neuroscientific techniques (EEG). He has published one research paper in A*, 08 papers in A, and 06 papers in the B category of journals (ABDC). He was the topper of PGDM (Marketing) at IIM Ranchi. Besides, he has received Best Research Paper awards from IIM Lucknow (2018) and IIM Ahmedabad (2020). Pradeep Kumar serves as a reviewer in many journals of A*/A/B category. He has also received the Outstanding Reviewer Awards for three consecutive years (2021, 2022, & 2023) and in 2025 from Journal of Asia Business Studies (Emerald), an ABDC-listed journal. Before joining KJSIM, he was associated with IIM Bodh Gaya, BIMTECH (Greater Noida); UPES, Dehradun; RBS, Kochi; and State Govt Service at Deptt. of Health & Family Welfare at the Govt. of Jharkhand, India.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Prerna Manik Mahindroo is an Associate Professor with the Business Analytics Area at K J Somaiya Institute of Management. A distinguished academic, she holds top ranks in her B.Sc. (Hons.) in Mathematics, M.Sc. in Operational Research, and M.Phil. in Operational Research. Her expertise extends to teaching courses such as Application Based Analytics, Business Statistics, Basic and Advanced Business Research Methods, Decision Science, Social Media Analytics, and Quantitative Methods. Dr. Mahindroo earned her Doctorate in Operational Research from the University of Delhi and has publications in ‘B’ and ‘C’ category journals (ABDC list) and has published over 30 research papers in international journals (listed in Scopus, UGC and Web of Science) or proceedings of international conferences. She contributes to Somaiya Vidyavihar University by teaching Business Statistics, Research Methodology and Predictive Analytics to PhD scholars. She is a recognized PhD guide at Somaiya Vidyavihar University and is a member of the Doctoral Advisory Committee for several PhD scholars. In addition, she serves as the Associate Editor for Business Perspectives and Research (BPR), a UGC-approved, Scopus-indexed management journal (ABDC ‘C’ category), and is a reviewer for various reputable journals, including the Journal of Cleaner Production (ABDC ‘A’ category). Dr. Mahindroo has conducted numerous corporate training programs for prominent organizations such as Motilal Oswal, Aker Solutions, J B Pharma, Mahindra & Mahindra, Godrej & Boyce, and INS Hamla. She is also the Program Director for the PGDM (Executive) Operations & Supply Chain Management program at Godrej & Boyce. Committed to staying current in the dynamic field of Business Analytics, she continuously updates her proficiency in tools and software like Power BI, Tableau, JASP, JMP, Python, JMP (SAS), SPSS, AMOS, MINITAB, MEGASTAT, and MATLAB.

faculty.introduction: Ms. Purva Apte is an academic professional in the field of Commerce and Business Studies, with a unique combination of industry and teaching experience. She previously worked as a Financial Data Analyst at Tata Consultancy Services, where she gained valuable experience in financial data management, analytics, and business reporting. Currently, she serves as an Assistant Professor, teaching subjects related to Business Analytics, Data Analytics, and Business Intelligence in Dr. Shantilal K Somaiya School of Commerce and Business Studies. Her teaching approach focuses on integrating technology-driven learning, analytical thinking, and practical business applications to prepare students for modern business environments. Purva is actively engaged in academic research, with particular interest in Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, and digital tools in education. Her recent research explores the impact of AI tools such as ChatGPT on students’ critical thinking abilities and the growing role of data analytics in business decision-making. She aims to further strengthen her academic journey by pursuing a PhD in Commerce and Business Studies from SVU, focusing on data-driven decision making, artificial intelligence, and business analytics in education and industry.

faculty.introduction: DR. RACHANA DESAI IS AN ASSOCIATE PROFESSOR OF MATHEMATICS IN DEPARTMENT OF SCIENCE AND HUMANITIES, K. J. Somaiya SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING (KJSCE), MUMBAI.SHE IS THE CHAIRPERSON OF BOARD OF STUDIES, MATHEMATICS, Somaiya VIDYAVIHAR UNIVERSITY (SVU), MUMBAI. SHE IS ALSO A MEMBER OF ACADEMIC COUNCIL AND MEMBER OF BOARD OF EXAMINATION, SVU. HER DUAL RESEARCH INTERESTS FOCUS ON MATHEMATICS AND ENGINEERING EDUCATION RESEARCH. SHE IS AWARDED HE IGIP CERTIFICATE AND TITLE "IGIP INTERNATIONAL ENGINEERING EDUCATOR -ING.PAED.IGIP" BY IGIP (INTERNATIONAL SOCIETY FOR ENGINEERING PEDAGOGY), AUSTRIA IN 2023. DR. RACHANA HAS EARNED PH.D. DEGREE IN MATHEMATICS FROM SARDAR VALLABHBHAI NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY (SVNIT), SURAT. HER MAIN AREA OF INTEREST IS SPECIAL FUNCTIONS AND HER ORIGINAL RESEARCH IS FOCUSED ON “EXTENSION OF MITTAG-LEFFLER FUNCTIONS AND THEIR PROPERTIES”. DURING HER ACADEMICS, SHE HAS RECEIVED NUMEROUS NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL AWARDS IN BOTH CURRICULAR & CO-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES. HER EXCELLENCE IN RESEARCH IS RECOGNISED BY SEVERAL NOTABLE AWARDS IN THE FIELD OF MATHEMATICS SUCHAS ‘IMS (INDIAN MATHEMATICAL SOCIETY) AWARD FOR BEST PAPER PRESENTATION’, ‘ARUNA GUPTA AWARD’ FROM SOCIETY OF SPECIAL FUNCTION AND APPLICATION (SSFA), R&D AWARD FOR EXCELLENCE IN RESEARCH BY KJSCE ETC. WITH OVER 16+ YEARS OF TEACHING EXPERIENCE AND ADDED QUALIFICATION OF B.ED., SHE SERVES SVU AS CHAIRPERSON-BOARD OF STUDIES (MATHEMATICS), THE COORDINATOR- TEACHING LEARNING CENTRE, KJSCE ETC. SHE HAS COMPLETED HER INTERNATIONAL CERTIFICATION PROGRAM IIEECP (IUCEE INTERNATIONAL ENGINEERING EDUCATORS CERTIFICATION PROGRAM) FROM IUCEE (INDO-UNIVERSAL COLLABORATION FOR ENGINEERING EDUCATION). SHE IS RECOGNIZED FOR INNOVATIVE TEACHING TECHNIQUES AND OUT OF THE BOX IDEAS FOR ACTIVE LEARNING IN MATHEMATICS. DR. RACHANA IS A LIFE TIME MEMBER OF MATHEMATICAL ASSOCIATIONS SUCH AS INDIAN MATHEMATICAL SOCIETY (IMS), SOCIETY OF SPECIAL FUNCTION AND APPLICATION (SSFA), GUJARAT GANIT MANDAL, MATHEMATICS TEACHER'S ASSOCIATION (MTA) ETC. SHE ALSO SERVES JOURNAL OF ENGINEERING EDUCATION AND TRANSFORMATIONS (JEET) AS A REVIEWER. SHE HAS DELIVERED NUMBER OF TALKS AS RESOURCE PERSON AND SESSION CHAIR IN NATIONAL & INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCES & TRAINING PROGRAMS.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Rahul Prakash is currently working as an Assistant Professor in the Maya Somaiya School of Music & Performing Arts, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai. He received his initial music training from Shri Anil Soni. Later, He started learning Classical Vocal Music under ‘GURU-SHISHYA PARAMPARA’ from Pt. Baldev Raj Verma,(A Top-Grade Artist of All India Radio and Doordarshan and Doyen of the Indore Gharana), since 2008. He has been awarded Ph.D. on the Topic 'Hindustani Shastriya Sangeet Mein Ritukaleen Bandishon Ka Sangitik Vishleshan' in 2021. He is a 'B- High' graded approved artist of All India Radio and Doordarshan, Prasar Bharti, Govt. of India. He cleared the UGC National Eligibility Test (NET) twice in Music. He was a University Topper and College Topper during postgraduate and undergraduate studies. He has participated in music competitions and won prizes. He is a young Performing Artist representing Fourth generation of Indore Gharana established by Padma Bhushan Ustad Amir khan Sahab . He is trained basically in Khayal Gayaki. He is equally at ease with other genres such as Tarana, Thumri, Ghazal, Geet and Bhajans. He has performed in various cities of the country on numerous occasions. He was fortunate to perform as a group member in front of the President of India, Sh. Pranab Mukherjee (2014), the Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, Finance minister Shri Arun Jaitley (2016 &2017), and Vice President, M. Hamid Ansari (2012). Apart from being an eminent musician, He has also Published a Book Titled “Hindustani Shastriya Sangeet Mein Ritukaleen Bandishen Evam Raga”. He is a distinguished scholar with a number of research paper publication in reputed journals. He has presented several research papers in International and National seminars. He has been an Assistant Editor of 'SANGITIKA', a Peer-reviewed UGC listed journal on Indian music. He has been Awarded 'SANGEET RATNA SAMMAN' in 2022 & KALA BHUSHAN PURASKAR in 2024.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Ram Kishen.Y has completed his Master’s in Business Administration from GITAM University, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh in the year 1996 with Honours in Marketing. He has around 10 years of corporate experience. Dr.Ram Kishen.Y completed his PhD from Bharti Vidyapeeth University in Rural Marketing in the year 2010. He has close to 25 years of Teaching Experience and has served in the best of B-Schools across India. He is presently working as a Professor of Marketing at K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management (constituent institute under Somaiya Vidyavihar University) Mumbai (ranked among the top 20 Best B-schools in India) from the past 18 years in the Department of Marketing & International Business. His teaching and research interests are Rural Marketing, Sales & Distribution Management, Retail Management, Strategic Brand Management, and Strategic Marketing. He is a prolific author and has written around 5 textbooks on Rural & Agricultural Marketing, Management of Co-operatives, International Retail Marketing Strategies (all published by Jaico Books) and Strategic Brand Management (published by Ane Books) Dr. Ram Kishen.Y develops his own case studies for Teaching in B-Schools and Corporate Training purposes.. Dr. Ram Kishen.Y also undertakes Corporate Training and MDP’s for industry professionals. His Training and Consulting areas include Sales & Negotiation Strategies, Distribution & Channel Management Strategies, Rural Marketing Strategies, Creating & Building Customer Centric Organizations, Retail Management Strategies, Brand Planning and Strategy, Building Loyalty & Creating Relationships (CRM), Real Estate Marketing Strategies, Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC) domains. He has won 3 Awards as the Best Faculty in Marketing from various bodies.

faculty.introduction: Dr Rashmi Jain is a prudent industry marketing expert and a seasoned academician with over 22 years of years of rich experience in designing customer-centric strategies for growth, building innovative product roadmaps, go-to-market strategies for portfolios of products for some of the largest companies in India and training the bright young minds pursuing MBA to excel in marketing domain. Digital & Social Media Marketing, Marketing Analytics, Innovative Marketing Technology (Martech), Customer Experience, Design Thinking, and Data visualization are her areas of expertise. In these domains, she has undertaken consultancy projects with organizations like Future Group, law enforcement agencies, Cogknit technologies etc Dr Jain has trained many industry professionals through customized executive training programs (Management Development Programs) in large organizations like Godrej & Boyce, Wellness Forever, Future Group, IIIP, Future group, Infidigit Solutions and many more. A blend of thought-provoking concepts, industry-specific examples/ case studies, and hands-on projects for the learners make her sessions highly engaging, interactive, and well-appreciated by the learners. She has been invited as an expert speaker at the World Marketing Summit organized by Kotler Impact and various summits organized by the SME Chamber of India. Dr Jain is actively involved in research that is relevant to the industry and significantly contributes to academic knowledge. Her research interests include AI in marketing, social media, customers’ interaction with technology etc. She has numerous research paper publications in national and international journals of repute, including ABDC journals. She is a reviewer for Sage Journals and Taylor& Francis journals. Dr Jain creates synergies between consultancy, research, and teaching to contribute significantly to academia and industry practices

faculty.introduction: Dr. Rinku Jain is a Professor in the Business Analytics Department at K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, with over 24 years of experience in research and academia. She holds a Ph.D. from Rajasthan University, Jaipur, and her research interests encompass Mathematics, Business Analytics, Financial & Marketing Analytics, and Sustainable Consumer Behavior. Dr. Jain has expertise in subjects such as Business Statistics, Predictive Analytics, Time Series Analysis, Forecasting Models, Optimization Techniques, and Data-Driven Decision-Making. She actively integrates statistical modeling, machine learning techniques, and real-world business applications into her teaching, leveraging software tools such as R, Python, JMP, SPSS, Excel, AMOS, SmartPLS, and Tableau for data analysis, visualization, and decision-making. She currently serves as the Convocation Chairperson and Division In-charge for the BADS Minor course and is also a Ph.D. guide at Somaiya Vidyavihar University. Additionally, she is a member of the Board of Studies (BOS) for the Business Analytics Department, contributing to curriculum development and academic advancements in the field. Dr. Jain has an extensive research portfolio, having published in ABDC, ABS, Web of Science, and Scopus-indexed national and international journals. Her recent research focuses on the SERVQUAL model in higher education, green purchase behavior, and the impact of promotions on sustainable consumer choices. She has also explored the role of social media influencers and family dynamics in shaping consumer health consciousness and online purchasing decisions. She has presented research papers at numerous national and international conferences, receiving Best Research Paper Awards for her impactful contributions. As part of her commitment to sustainability, she has aligned her five-year research plan with topics related to sustainable business practices and analytics-driven decision-making. Beyond academia, Dr. Jain has designed and facilitated corporate training programs for organizations such as Godrej & Boyce, NSE, BSE, NISM, INS Hamla, Mahindra & Mahindra, among others.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Rohan Kothurkar has 14+ years of combined teaching and industry experience in Mechanical Engineering, with expertise in production processes, material science, finite element analysis, engineering mechanics, CAD modeling, biomechanics, and biomaterials. His industry experience includes roles in production and planning, while his academic career has focused on interdisciplinary research and translational healthcare applications. His primary research interests include biomechanics, gait analysis, musculoskeletal modeling, finite element analysis, rehabilitation engineering, and machine learning applications in healthcare. His work particularly focuses on knee biomechanics, lower-limb deformities, osteoarthritis, total knee replacement, and movement analysis using motion capture systems and force plates. He has contributed to several research projects involving gait analysis in children and elderly populations, rehabilitation studies, orthopedic biomechanics, and assistive device development. Dr. Kothurkar actively collaborates with leading clinicians, hospitals, physiotherapists, and biomechanics laboratories across India. He serves as an Academic Editor for PLOS ONE Journal and is an Editorial Board Member of Apollo Medicine Journal . He has reviewed 100+ manuscripts for more than 25 international journals and has published research papers, book chapters, and patents in the areas of biomechanics, rehabilitation, and orthopedic applications.

faculty.introduction: Dr Rudraksha Sakrikar is an Adjunct Associate Professor of Sanskrit at K. J. Somaiya Institute of Dharma Studies. He teaches topics related to Indian Philosophy, Sanskrit, Yogashastra in UG and PG programmes. He was awarded a PhD in Sanskrit by the University of Mumbai in August 2019. The topic of his research was – ‘An Indian Perspective Regarding the Science of Weather Forecast as Described in Sanskrit Texts’. Dr Rudraksha received six gold medals and one silver medal for standing first in M.A. at the Department of Sanskrit as well as the faculty of Arts of Banaras Hindu University in the year 2008. Dr Rudraksha has authored 56 entries and edited 38 entries on Yoga for Marathi Vishwakosha. Dr Rudraksha is also a Sarangi player and he performs at various places in India.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Rupal Thakkar holds a Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in Science and Education, Post Graduate Diploma in Management Education (PGDME)and is NET qualified. She is currently serving as an Associate Professor at K. J. Somaiya School of Education. A first ranker throughout her education programme, Dr. Thakkar brings strong academic credentials and extensive experience in teacher education. At the undergraduate level, Dr. Thakkar teaches Educational Psychology and Environmental Education in the B.Ed. programme. At the postgraduate level, she handles Curriculum Design, Development and Evaluation and Educational Management for the M.Ed. programme, and Understanding of Organisational Behaviour for the PGDEM programme. Her teaching is characterised by clarity, academic rigour and learner-centred pedagogical practices. An ardent environmentalist, Dr. Thakkar has conceptualised, initiated, and successfully implemented a wide range of experiential learning–based initiatives through the Environmental Club, promoting sustainability awareness and active student engagement. Her research interests primarily focus on Experiential Learning in Environmental Education and the development of strategies and instructional modules for effective English language teaching. Dr. Thakkar is associated as a Counsellor for the M.Ed. (Education) programme of IGNOU. She has presented research at national and international forums, including a joint paper with Dr. Kalpana Kharade at the London International Conference on Education (2011), which received wide appreciation. She successfully completed an ICSSR-sponsored two-year research project (2013–2015) on training vernacular-medium teachers in the use of ICT for language teaching. She has also contributed as an e-content developer for the M.Ed. programme under an MHRD-sponsored project coordinated by the Department of Educational Technology, SNDT Women’s University. In 2025, Dr. Thakkar served as a Resource Person for Pedagogy of English at the Rachana Fellowship Winter School, organised by the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS), on the theme Inclusive Education, engaging student teachers from across India. She has also served as a Reviewer for the International Conference on Envisioning Industry 5.0: A Holistic Learning Environment, organised by Manjara Charitable Trust, MCT Mauritius Institute, and TIFR (HBCSE). Her areas of expertise include: Experiential Learning in Environmental Education Reflective Practices in Teacher Education Integration of ICT in Language Teaching Dr. Thakkar is a Doctoral Advisory Board Member at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore. She has co-authored two academic books, Foundations of OB and HRM and Educational Psychology for Learning and Teaching. She has successfully guided four M.Ed. dissertations (University of Mumbai and Somaiya Vidyavihar University) and is currently supervising four Ph.D. scholars.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Rupali Paranjpe holds a Ph.D. awarded by SNDT Women’s University, Mumbai..The title of her research is "The role of microfinance in entrepreneurial development". With over 18 plus years of experience in academia, she specializes in teaching courses such as Financial Accounting, Cost and Management Accounting, Financial Management, Financial Analysis and Reporting, Financial Statement Analysis, and Financial Markets and Instruments. An accomplished researcher, Dr. Rupali has made significant contributions to the field of microfinance and entrepreneurship. Notably, her research paper, "Impact of Microfinance on Enhanced Well-Being of Self-Help Group Women in the Post-COVID Scenario," was awarded the First Runner-Up Award at the Business Analytics Conference. This paper was subsequently published in Model Assisted Statistics and Applications (Vol. 17, No. 4, pp. 265-271, 2022). Dr. Rupali had also received research funding from SVU in 2020, enabling further exploration in the field. Their recent research paper, "Impact of Family Values & Upbringing on Sibling Relationships: Moderating Role of Wealth Inheritance," has been accepted for publication in The Social Science Journal by Taylor & Francis. This prestigious Q2 publication, indexed in Scopus and the Web of Science, has an impact factor of 1.8 and a competitive acceptance rate of just 17%. In addition to research, Dr. Rupali has authored a case study titled "Dax Water Tech: Search for Right Capital," which was published by Ivey Publishing, Canada, in January 2024. Dedicated to advancing knowledge and fostering student learning, Dr. Rupali seamlessly integrates research and teaching to inspire the next generation of professionals.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Sandip Balwe is an Assistant Professor at SIRAC, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, with a strong interdisciplinary background in medicinal chemistry, drug discovery, and nanomedicine.His research focuses on the rational design of next-generation therapeutics and nanocarrier-based drug delivery systems for complex diseases. He has published 25 high-impact research articles in leading international journals such as Nano Today, Journal of Nanobiotechnology, ACS Chemistry of Materials, Nonconvergence, and Bioorganic & Medicinal Chemistry Letters with an h-index of 13. Prior to his current position, Dr. Balwe served as a Research Professor at Seoul National University, South Korea, where he contributed to the design and development of a novel small-molecule therapeutics for the treatment of fibrosis, which has progressed to clinical trials. His research at SNU also involved advancing nanomedicine-based strategies for targeted therapeutic delivery. In addition, he has significant industrial experience as a Scientist at Tata’s Advinus Therapeutics Ltd, where he contributed to drug discovery programs targeting metabolic disorders, infectious diseases, and pain. He was also part of a lead optimization team involved in the development of next-generation FAAH inhibitors that have successfully completed Phase I clinical trials. His research integrates synthetic chemistry, medicinal chemistry, nanotechnology, and computational approaches to bridge the gap between laboratory discovery and clinical translation, with a focus on developing scalable and impactful therapeutic solutions.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Saranya Thaloor is an Associate Professor in the Department of Mass Communication at Somaiya School of Humanities and Social Sciences, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai. With a strong commitment to academic excellence, she integrates innovative pedagogy, interdisciplinary research, and community engagement in her academic practice. Dr. Thaloor teaches across undergraduate and postgraduate programs in areas such as Communication for Development, Environmental Communication, Research Methodology, Public Relations, Advertising and Marketing Research, Data Journalism, and Consumer Behaviour. An active contributor to curriculum design and a Board of Studies (BOS) member since 2021, she has aligned syllabi with NEP 2020, embedding critical thinking, research-based learning, and application-oriented projects. Her research spans digital media, sustainability, agriculture communication, tourism, gender studies, and AI in media. She has published in Scopus and Web of Science indexed journals, ABDC-listed journals, and edited volumes, and has presented her work internationally, including in Japan (2025). She is a recognized PhD guide mentoring six doctoral scholars and has guided numerous postgraduate dissertations. Two of her scholars are nearing submission. Dr. Thaloor also serves as PhD Coordinator, Associate Editor of the university newsletter, Examination Committee representative, and Core Committee member for major university initiatives. She actively fosters industry-academia collaboration, organizes conferences and conclaves such as on science communication, and facilitates student publications and research dissemination. Known for her clarity, empathy, and collaborative leadership, Dr. Thaloor continues to advance media education through innovation, sustainability-focused scholarship, and strong student mentorship.

faculty.introduction: I am an Assistant Professor of Finance and Taxation at Dr. Shantilal K. Somaiya School of Commerce and Business Studies, with over 16 years of experience in higher education. With a strong inclination towards mathematics and quantitative analysis, I particularly enjoy teaching Operations Research and applying analytical approaches to business and financial decision-making. faculty.introduction: Dr. Satyendra is General Management faculty with two Ph.D. (from India and China) and MBA in Marketing from Mumbai University. He has more than 18 years of industry experience in India and Abroad. His research interest lies in International Relations, internationalisation of education, India-China Relations, BRICS and Affiliate Marketing. Since 2007, he has been visiting professor to various management institutes in Mumbai and University of Mumbai (2016-20). He has joined as Assistant Professor (Sr. Scale) in K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management in March 2018. He teaches General Management Course, International Relations and Diplomacy and Mandarin to MBA students. Since 2019, he is Chairperson for Funded Research Projects and institute coordinator for Scheme for Promotion of Academic and Research Collaboration (SPARC). Dr. Satyendra is also Director of International Relations for Somaiya Vidyavihar University and responsible for Foreign University Tie-ups to facilitate International Students Exchange, Faculty Exchange, Overseas Immersion Program, Joint Research and Conference. He has contributed to collaborate with 20 reputed foreign universities in USA, Australia, UK, Italy, China, Belgium, South Africa, New Zeland, Argentina, Germany, France, Ireland. He is the program director of Doing Business in India (MDP) program. He has received Best Research Paper Award in 16 th SIMSR Global Marketing Conference. He is coordinator in four International Funded Projects, three projects with British Council Going Global Partnership Grants in collaboration with Aston University (2021-22) and Coventry University (2022-23) in UK and one project from SPARC in collaboration with Saint Petersburg Polytechnic University, Russia (2023-25). He was Co-convenor for International Conference on Sustainable Wase Management and Circular Economy (29 th November-2nd December, 2023). Dr. Satyendra was awarded MHRD, Govt. of India Scholarship (International Cultural Exchange Program) for Ph.D. research (2000-04) and "The Pillar of Hindustanee Society" by Trans Asian Chamber of Commerce and Industry in 2015. He was featured in national and international news paper media and UTV, CCTV television for his contribution.

faculty.introduction: Ms. Sayali Nene is currently working as an Assistant Professor in Dr. Shantilal K. Somaiya School of Commerce and Business Studies, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai having over five years of combined experience - two years in the corporate sector and three years in academia. She has completed her Masters in Advanced Accountancy and has qualified NET-JRF (Commerce) exam with 99.81 perecntile. She is currently pursuing her Ph.D with her research topic being formally approved by the Doctoral Committee. Her research area specilaization is in Accounting, Finance and Taxation and has presented research papers in International Conferences. Passionate about research, Sayali is driven by a desire to explore real-world problems and find practical solutions through academic inquiry. She thoroughly enjoys teaching and brings both industry insight and research-based perspectives into the classroom to engage and inspire the students.

faculty.introduction: Dr Shital Mehta is a faculty member in the Department of Accounting and Finance at Somaiya Vidyavihar University, where she serves as Ph.D. guide and IQAC coordinator and heads the Info Cell and NAAC Criterion II. She holds a Ph.D. in Accountancy and an M.Com. from the University of Mumbai, qualified for the UGC-NET with JRF on her first attempt, and is a Company Secretary (ICSI). With over a decade of teaching and research experience across institutions including K.J. Somaiya College of Science and Commerce and Smt. Kamala Mehta V.W.A. College of Commerce, she has guided doctoral research, mentored undergraduate and postgraduate students, and contributed to institutional quality assurance and examination processes. Her research interests span ESG investing, central bank digital currencies, and deepfake-related financial fraud, with several papers published in peer-reviewed and ABDC-indexed journals. She has also co-authored textbooks on research methodology and Business Development for M.Com. and F.Y.B.Com. programmes. In recognition of her contributions to teaching and research, she received the Somaiya Promising Faculty Award for 2024–25.

My research areas of specialization include Nanotechnology, Phytochemistry, Human Genetics and Molecular Biology. Research and teaching are my passion. My scientific curiosity is the driving force that enables me to question and pursue research that I hope will benefit the society.
