faculty.introduction: Prof. Sudarshan Sirsat, an accomplished and dedicated data science faculty, currently serving as an Assistant Professor in the field of Data Science in K J Somaiya Institute of Management. With a profound passion for leveraging data-driven insights to solve complex problems, Prof. Sudarshan has profound experience in both academia and industry. Education: Prof. Sirsat holds NET for assistant professorship and he is University of Mumbai and Somaiya Vidyavihar University approved Data Science faculty. He worked in various prestigious institutions like K J Somaiya Institute of Management since, Thakur institute of Management Science career Development and Research, Hiray Institute of Computer Application and ABM knowledgeware pvt. ltd. holding various positions like Java Developer, Assistant professor and lecturer. Where he taught various Management, computer science and data science subjects. Prof. Sirsat has research interests span a broad range of areas within data science, including but not limited to predictive modeling, natural language processing, software project management, and Sentiment Analysis in regional languages. They have published extensively in reputable journals and conferences, disseminating their innovative research findings to the wider scientific community. Professional Skills: Professor Sirsat possesses a deep understanding of various programming languages and tools commonly used in data science, such as Python, R, SQL, and google colab. They have honed their skills in Mobile Application Development, statistical analysis, and machine learning techniques, allowing them to extract valuable insights from complex datasets. Leadership and Professional Associations: Prof. Sirsat is an esteemed member of several professional associations and societies like IEEE and ISTE and organized MDP, FDP and various national and international conferences in the field of computer science. With their exceptional academic background, extensive research contributions, and commitment to teaching excellence, Prof. Sirsat is an invaluable asset to any institution seeking to advance the field of data science and nurture the next generation of data scientists.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Sudha Gupta is a senior faculty member in the Department of Electronics Engineering at K J Somaiya School of Engineering (KJSSE), Mumbai, and currently serves as Professor and A Dean of Students’ Affairs. With a career spanning more than 26 years, she is recognized for her academic excellence, student leadership, and contributions to research and innovation. She actively contributes to the institute and Somaiya Vidyavihar University through her involvement in several key committees. She currently serves as the Chairperson of the SVU Students’ Grievances Redressal Committee and is a member of the SVU University Cultural Committee (UCC), the SVU Students’ Welfare Committee, and the SVU University Electoral Literacy Club. Dr. Gupta holds a B.E. in Electronics Engineering from Government Engineering College, Ujjain, an M.E. in Electronics, and a Ph.D. from VJTI Mumbai, where her research focused on the analysis and prediction of cascade failures in power transmission systems. Her work has been published in globally reputed journals, including IEEE Transactions on Industrial Electronics, Springer, Elsevier, IEEE letters, Inderscience, IEEE xplore etc. She has guided numerous B.Tech, M.Tech, and Ph.D. students, contributing to impactful research in areas such as healthcare, agriculture, sustainability, prediction and analytics. Dr. Gupta is an active contributor to the Biomedical Engineering & Technology Incubation Centre (BETiC–KJSCE), working in collaboration with IIT Bombay, and has received institutional funding for healthcare innovation projects. One of her guided M.Tech projects, “Design and Implementation of Fundus Camera for Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy,” received the SVU Star Innovation Award 2019. She also serves as a reviewer for several international journals and conferences and has submitted multiple major and minor research proposals to national funding agencies. She has been invited as a speaker at international conferences in Bangkok, Dubai, and the UAE, and previously served as a Member of the Board of Studies (Electronics Engineering), University of Mumbai (2006–2012). During her tenure, she contributed to curriculum development, academic committees, and faculty development programs, including ISTE-approved STTPs and workshops. Her academic and research interests include Artificial intelligence, machine learning, Image Processing, IoT, Communication Networks, and Biomedical Engineering. Driven by a passion for mentoring and innovation, Dr. Gupta continues to support research-oriented education and interdisciplinary technological advancements. faculty.introduction: Sudhir Nayak is a familiar face at most music festivals in India and has gained recognition as a sensitive harmonium accompanist to several vocalists. Sudhir is equally at home with harmonium solo renditions as he is with accompaniment and has performed at different places, globally. A disciple of the Harmonium maestro and Guru Pandit Tulsidas Borkar, Sudhir also received training from the noted vocalist, composer and Guru Pandit Jitendra Abhisheki in the nuances of Raag Sangeet. Primarily trained in the Hindustani Music tradition, Sudhir has also studied various other genres of Indian music. At an early age, Sudhir had the honour of accompanying stalwarts in the field of Indian Music like Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, Pt. Jitendra Abhisheki, Pt. Firoz Dastur, Pt. Ram Ashreya Jha, Pt. S C R Bhat, Pt. Dinkar Kaikini, Pt.Yastwantbuva Joshi, Pt. Sangameshwar Gurav, Pt. Babanrao Haldankar, Pt. Jasraj, Pt. Rajan Misra, Pt. Prabhakar Karekar, Ustad Rashid Khan, Vidushi Gangubai Hangal, Vidushi Padmavati Shaligram, Dr. Prabha Atre, Vidushi Shobha Gurtu, Pt. Birju Maharaj, Ustad Zakir Hussain, to name a few. He is also regularly associated with contemporary musicians like Shubha Mudgal, Ulhas Kashalkar, Sajan Misra, Ajoy Chakravarty, Omkarnath Gulvady, Aneesh Pradhan, Padma Talwalkar, Shruti Sadolikar-Katkar, Ajay Pohankar, Venkateshkumar, Shounak Abhisheki, Ashwini Bhide-Deshpande, Arati Ankalikar- Tikekar and Devaki Pandit among many others. Sudhir’s musical performances are regularly featured on Indian television and commercial recordings. Sudhir has also composed music for many projects and albums, some of which have been recorded and published commercially. He has also cut a Harmonium Solo Album titled,’The Acoustic Keyboard in Indian Music- Solo Harmonium’, published by Underscore Records. Sudhir has the honour of having performed along with Pandit Bhimsen Joshi at the Central Hall of the Parliament of India, on the occasion marking the Golden Jubilee celebrations of India’s independence and with Shubha Mudgal to mark the 60 years of Parliament of India. He has also performed widely in the USA, the UK, Canada, Mexico, Europe, Australia, the Far Eastern and the Middle Eastern countries. Sudhir has been invited as a visiting lecturer often through the Department of Fine Arts and Music, University of Pittsburgh, USA. He has also performed and conducted interactive sessions for music students of Stanford, Berkeley, Brandies, Yale University and Ithaca College- USA, Griffith University- Brisbane, Monash University-Melbourne and other educational institutions and universities around the globe. He has also participated in many international festivals and projects like The Indian Voices Festival- BBC Proms Festival at The Royal Albert Hall (London), The Perth Arts Festival (Perth) and Sacred Music Festival (Brisbane), etc. Sudhir also participates in cross-cultural collaborations being a part of the ensemble ‘Koshish’ and also in international projects like ‘Fearless Nadia’, ‘Bridge of Dreams’, etc. Passionate about the study and development of the Harmonium, Sudhir curated an exhibition of antique Harmoniums from his personal vintage collection, along with providing information about the history and the status of the Harmonium, in the International Music Festival ‘Baajaa Gaajaa- 2009’, which was appreciated by many reputed personalities from the field of Music and fine arts. He also conducts workshops and interactive sessions related to the Harmonium and other topics related to Indian Music at different places in India and abroad. Currently Sudhir serves as Guest Faculty at the Mumbai University and as Adjunct Professor at Somaiya University. Sudhir is part of the advisory in many cultural committees and also curates many cultural events and festivals. Sudhir holds the position of the Secretary of the Village Music Club, a group of music enthusiasts involved in presenting and propagating Indian music and traditional arts, based in Thakur Village of Kandivali East, Mumbai. Following his rich experience and eclectic approach towards music and arts across the globe, presently, Sudhir has constructively dedicated his efforts along with a group of art enthusiasts, towards the development of KALA COAST, a movement for the arts with its flagship project being the Global Music and Arts Village, a centre of music and arts in Coastal Karnataka. (www.kalacoast.com).

faculty.introduction: Assistant Professor Ms. Takshashila Jadhav Ms. Takshashila Jadhav holds an M.A. and M.Ed. in Education and has qualified the UGC NET in Education. She is currently pursuing her Ph.D. and demonstrates a profound commitment to working for the betterment of society through education. She is a proactive and result oriented professional, known for delivering excellence through effective communication, coordination, planning, and execution. She consistently mentors and motivates her students toward social transformation through education. Driven by this commitment, she designed and published a MOOC on Human Rights Education under the aegis of the OE4BW International Online Mentoring Program, UNESCO, in 2019. She has also delivered a video lecture for the annual Eduscope series organized by the UNESCO Chair at the Jožef Stefan Institute, Slovenia. In 2021, her proposal for another MOOC on Social Justice Education was accepted by the OE4BW platform under UNESCO. Under her able guidance and leadership, her students have organized several street plays across different parts of Mumbai city on diverse social issues. These initiatives focused on creating awareness and suggesting practical solutions through existing government schemes and constitutional provisions to address challenges arising from socio cultural, traditional, economic, and political domains. Her sustained efforts to foster just, humane, and harmonious conditions of coexistence have been widely appreciated by the community and have also received critical acclaim in local newspapers.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Tina Tambe is a Kathak exponent whose performance career spans more than three decades, featuring solo and ensemble presentations at major festivals and cultural platforms across India and abroad. Known for her precision in technique and sensitive interpretative style, she has created and performed thematic works, collaborative productions with varied percussion traditions, and choreographies that explore both classical grammar and contemporary expression within Kathak. Her teaching experience extends over two decades, supported by her role as a registered teacher and examiner with the Akhil Bharatiya Gandharva Mahavidyalaya Mandal, Mumbai. She also serves on the Judges Panel of the Association of Indian Universities and is frequently invited to evaluate performances at prestigious competitions, reflecting her standing within the classical dance community. Her workshops, lecture-demonstrations, and training initiatives—conducted in India and internationally—demonstrate her commitment to sharing the artistic, theoretical, and cultural dimensions of the form. Beyond the classical dance sphere, Dr. Tambe has worked across television, radio, and film. She has acted in TV serials including Chittor Ki Rani Padmini Ka Johur and Powder on Sony TV, and the Marathi serial Avghachi Sansar on Zee Marathi. Her media experience includes working as a radio jockey for Akashavani’s Gyan Vani channel, anchoring programs on Indore Doordarshan, and dubbing English documentary films into Marathi for DD Sahyadri. She has also appeared as a dancer in a National Award-winning documentary film on Mandavgadh (Madhya Pradesh) and in the music video Boond, the first video album by Meet Brothers released on Zee Music. Her diverse artistic engagements—spanning performance, choreography, teaching, adjudication, and media—inform a holistic understanding of the performing arts and enrich her contribution to the academic and creative environment

faculty.introduction: Biography Hardworking teacher. Committed soul. A believer in the quote that there is no elevator to success you have to take the stairs. With this thought I took all my experience with zeal and made my students work hard even though there may be many hurdles. Before beginning my teaching career in Higher Education I worked in elementary schools having children who were first generation learners. My passion for teaching enabled me to motivate my students at all levels be it primary, secondary or college level. Throughout my career I saw students with learning difficulties developing a fixed mindset towards learning .At Primary level they faced difficulties in different subjects with no support at homes. Even at Teacher Education level I came across students anxious to face Maths classrooms. Since Mathematics Education bought fear and anxiety among my pre service teachers, my aim was to create growth mindset among my students and enable them to believe that nothing is impossible. My role as a teacher educator became to provide a positive push. A smile. A word of optimism and hope. And that you can do it when things are tough. Everything then falls in the right place. My research area of interest is Inclusive Education .I am particularly interested in Gender studies, Multicultural education and Peace Education. I always wanted to prepare teachers for the global era. My major research project focussed on Infusion of Multicultural elements into the curriculum to develop social adjustment among students of minority schools . My aim was to enable teachers of minority schools to develop and implement instructional material so that their students are prepared to co exist in diverse classrooms and live in a peaceful society. Currently, my research focus is related to LGBT inclusion. I am open to have collaborative researches with faculty of other institutions in India as well as abroad. faculty.introduction: Dr Vandana Tandon Khanna is a Professor and Program Coordinator for PhD at K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai, in Marketing Management. She has a Doctorate in Services Marketing (November 2003) from the Dept. of Management Studies, Kurukshetra University, Haryana, and a Master in Tourism Management from the Deptt. of Tourism, Kurukshetra University, Kurukshetra, India. She has over 26 years of diversified teaching experience. She has developed and delivered various new courses. Her teaching and research interests are in the areas of Services Marketing, Internal Marketing, Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty, Customer Perception, CRM, Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty, Customer Experience Management and Tourism and Hospitality Management. Apart from teaching, Dr Vandana also holds various administrative responsibilities. She is a recognized teacher from the University of Mumbai for postgraduate programs. She has been a PhD guide at the University of Mumbai since July 2012 and at Somaiya Vidyavihar University. She is also a co-guide at Lincoln University, Malaysia. 6 scholars have completed PhDs under her guidance from the University of Mumbai. Currently, six research scholars are pursuing their PhD under her guidance. She is also an invited guest lecturer at the American University of Emirates (AUE). Dr Vandana has presented and published several research papers both in National and International conferences & journals. Dr Vandana also conducts MDPs in the areas of Marketing Management, Customer Satisfaction & Loyalty, CEM, and CRM. Dr Vandana has also developed and published cases in journals and The Case Centre. She is keenly interested in case study development in an emerging economies context. Dr Vandana is a member of the Advisory Council of the International Journal of Marketing Principles and Practices of the International Institute of Marketing Professionals, a Senior Member of the International Economics Development Research Centre (IEDRC), a Member of Marketing in Asia Group (MAG), an Editorial Board Member of the K U School Journal of Kenyatta University, and a Certified Lead Auditor as a QMS Auditor based on ISO 9001:2008 standards. Dr Vandana was awarded the 'Best Professor in Marketing and International Business' in 2017 on the 25th Silver Jubilee year of the Business School Affaire & Dewang Mehta National Education Awards and 'Women in Education' in 2018. The Dewang Mehta National Education Awards are India's largest Education Awards Contest and are held as a part of the World Marketing Congress; Best Marketing Teacher of the Year 2018 in Mumbai by Guru Nanak Institute of Management Studies Centre of Excellence in Marketing in Feb 2019; and Prof. Indira Parekh Women in Education Leaders award by the World Education Congress in July 2019; and 50 under 50 Educator by Making India Employable in September 2023.

faculty.introduction: VENKATARAMANAN IS A ASSISTANT PROFESSOR IN THE DEPARTMENT OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY AT K J Somaiya SCHOOL OF ENGINEERING, VIDYAVIHAR, MUMBAI, MAHARASHTRA 400077. HE HAS 57 PAPERS THAT HAVE BEEN PUBLISHED IN INTERNATIONAL JOURNALS AND PRESENTED AT NATIONAL AND INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCES. HIS RESEARCH FOCUSES ON NEXT-GENERATION WIRELESS TECHNOLOGIES, MIMO-OFDM, IOT, AI, ML, AND VLSI SYSTEMS. HE HOLDS TWO APPLICATION PATENTS AND ONE DESIGN PATENT. HE REVIEWED OVER 180 PAPERS IN REFEREED JOURNALS SUCH AS THE INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS (WILEY), IEEE JOURNAL OF THE INTERNET OF THINGS (IEEE), COMPUTER COMMUNICATION (ELSEVIER), IET: SIGNAL PROCESSING (IET), JOURNAL OF NETWORK AND COMPUTER APPLICATIONS (ELSEVIER), INTERNATIONAL JOURNAL OF INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY EDUCATION (IGI GLOBAL PUBLISHING), IET NETWORKS (WILEY), DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS AND NETWORKS (ELSEVIER), AND VEHICULAR COMMUNICATION. HE SERVES ON THE EDITORIAL BOARDS OF SEVERAL JOURNALS, INCLUDING INTERNATIONAL RESEARCH PUBLICATION HOUSE, ADVANCES IN MOBILE LEARNING EDUCATIONAL RESEARCH, AND FRONTIERS IN APPLIED MATHEMATICS AND STATISTICS. HE DELIVERED OVER 18 INVITED GUEST LECTURES, SEMINARS, AND WORKSHOPS AT A VARIETY OF ORGANISATIONS, INCLUDING THE TOP 50 NIRF INSTITUTIONS. HE WAS A MENTOR FOR TWO INTERNATIONAL CONTESTS, CANSAT AND THE ROVER CHALLENGE. THE TEAM COMPETED IN A VARIETY OF CONTESTS AROUND THE UNITED STATES, EUROPE, AND ELSEWHERE. HE HAS AROUND TEN RESEARCH COLLABORATIONS WITH INTERNATIONAL AND NATIONAL PROFESSORS. HE RECEIVED AN INVITATION TO TEACH A SKILL-BASED 5G COURSE (IOT BUILDER). THE MADHYA PRADESH STATE SKILL DEVELOPMENT AND EMPLOYMENT GENERATION BOARD (MPSSDEGB) AND THE FOUNDATION FOR INNOVATION AND TECHNOLOGY TRANSFER (FITT) OF THE INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY DELHI (IIT DELHI) ARE WORKING TOGETHER TO RUN THIS COURSE.

faculty.introduction: I am Prof. Venus Jain, a historian and educator with a long-standing commitment to academic leadership, research, and the study of religion and culture. My professional journey began with the Galaxy Education System in Rajkot, after which I moved to the Global Indian International School in Gandhidham, where I served as Principal and Director (Education). Later, I took on the role of Group Director at the Shri Ram Group of Colleges in Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, gaining extensive experience in higher education administration. I subsequently joined Amity University, Noida, as Junior Vice President, where I played a key role in establishing the Department of History and served as the Global Stream Coordinator for History. At present, I serve as Professor of Jainism at the Centre of Studies in Jainism, K. J. Somaiya Institute of Dharma Studies, under Somaiya Vidyavihar University. Alongside teaching and research, I contribute to academia as a member of the editorial boards of several national and international journals. I have authored books that have received international recognition, including System of Devadasis in India – Tradition or Travesty and Celebrating Tenfold Virtue. My work has been honored with several prestigious recognitions, including the President’s Award from the President of India, as well as titles such as the Outstanding Educator & Scholar Award and the Distinguished Woman Educator & Scholar Award. Over the years, I have published more than 95 research papers and publications, many indexed in Scopus, focusing on themes such as religion, cultural history, and the role of women in religious practices. I am also a Distinguished Fellow of the National Foundation for Entrepreneurship Development, Coimbatore. Beyond academia, I frequently engage with wider audiences through television programs and radio platforms such as Radio 90.8 FM. As a keynote speaker at national and international conferences, I focus on cultural history, the role of women in religious traditions, and the global relevance of Jain philosophy.

faculty.introduction: Dr. Vilasini Jadhav is currently working as an Associate Professor in the area of Marketing and IB at K. J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai, India. She is Science (Statistics) Graduate from University of Mumbai and has done Masters in Business Administration with Marketing specialization from University of Pune. She has a prior work experience of more than 23 years, comprising of 9 years in industry and 14 years in academics. Her industry experience of 9 years covers areas such as Retail Category Management, Product Management, Sales Management and Customer Relationship Management in Marketing. Dr. Vilasini Jadhav has completed her Ph.D. from University of Mumbai. Her research areas include Retailing in India and Other Countries, Online and Offline Retail, and Retail Consumer Behavior. In her doctoral program she has worked on the Online Buying Behavior of the college students in Mumbai. She has participated and presented in national and international conferences and published in national and international journals.

faculty.introduction: Ms. Yogita Kiran Borse is working as Assistant Professor(AP) in the department of Information Technology since JAN 2008. She is an active researcher in the field of Digital Security and Blockchain Technology & Applications. She involved in conducting co-curricular activites for the students and motivate them to apply their knowledege by providing different internships. She is also invited to conduct trainings for corporate employees/academicians/students on advanced technologies such as Blockchain, IOT Security and Latex. Her major areas of teaching are Blockchain Technology, Cloud security, Information and Network Security, Number and Coding theory, Data structures & Algorithms.
